lines.text: Many learners say: I pretend to travel next year.
Better: I intend to travel next year.
Pretend means to act, not to plan.
The first! I intend to study more.

en.tip: “Pretend” means to act. For “pretender”, use “intend” or “plan”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I pretend to travel next year.” The right way is “I intend to travel next year.” In Portuguese “pretender” means to have plans, but in English “pretend” means to act. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
